messages.label: Step 0 (listening_for_discover) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_first_request. Cond: is_dhcp_discover() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac)
Step 1 (listening_for_first_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_renewing_request. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac)

Step 2 (listening_for_renewing_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_rebinding_request. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac) and dst_ip_equals(expected.server_id_be)

Step 3 (listening_for_rebinding_request) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac) and dst_ip_is_broadcast() and (option_absent(54))
